summary:
The PR deepens the dashboard view-model seam by exposing employee-row construction through HomeViewDerived and removing EmployeesSection's imports of internal derivation helpers.
- Reuses one set of workspace lookups and relationship facts for bulk and paged employee rows.
- Injects buildEmployeeTableRow into EmployeesSection through the page-section composition layer.
- Adds a composition test covering row consistency, inactive employees, missing roles, metrics, and manager-option aliasing.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR appears safe to merge with no actionable correctness or security defects identified.

The new seam delegates to the same employee-row implementation and shared workspace-derived context as the existing bulk path, while the sole component boundary is updated consistently and covered by a composition test.
